get_bounds_sparse_voxel: get the min and max x, y, z bounds from a sparse voxel list or schematic
coord_to_index_flatten: convert a 3D coordinate in a cube to its flattened array index given the side length
index_to_coord_unflatten: convert a flattened array index back to its 3D coordinate in a cube given the side length
densify_sparse_to_dense: convert a sparse voxel block list into a dense numpy array with optional block ID values
shift_sparse_voxel_to_origin: shift a sparse voxel segment to the origin and return the shifted segment with its shift vector
